svg.title: OpticsLAB Desktop Application Full Workspace Structure
svg.desc: Detailed high-precision UI diagram showcasing the complete desktop application layout for OpticsLAB: Top main menu & toolbars, left optical tree inspector, central 3D CAD viewport with raytracing handles, right spot diagram & energy analysis plots, and bottom status bar in Inkscape layers.

g.inkscape:label: 1. Window Frame & Toolbars
g.title: Layer 1: Window Frame, Header & Main Toolbars
g.desc: App window outer container, OS window controls, main menu bar, and icon toolbars.
g.text: OpticsLAB v2.4 Desktop — 3D Optical Bench & Ray Tracing Workspace [Telescope_Design.opl]
File Edit Component Raytrace Analysis View Window Help

g.inkscape:label: 2. Left Panel (Tree & Properties)
g.title: Layer 2: Optical Tree Hierarchy & Property Inspector Panel
g.desc: Left dock containing scene component tree structure and property inspector fields.

g.inkscape:label: 3. Center 3D CAD Viewport
g.title: Layer 3: 3D CAD Raytracing Viewport & Gizmo Handles
g.desc: Central dark 3D CAD viewport displaying parallel laser rays, biconvex lens, focus convergence, and XYZ triad widget.

g.inkscape:label: 4. Right Panel (Analysis & Plots)
g.title: Layer 4: Spot Diagram & Enclosed Energy Analysis Plots
g.desc: Right dock containing live spot diagram target plot and energy distribution bar graph.

g.inkscape:label: 5. Bottom Status Bar
g.title: Layer 5: Application Status Bar
g.desc: Bottom status bar showing ray count, VisPy 3D rendering state, Z-position readout, and FPS.
